content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Shivaji University, Kolhapur, dated 25 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Shivaji University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Shivaji University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Senior Administrative Officer, 1 Office Assistant cum Data Operator.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Shivaji University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 2 December 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹. 1,000 per day for Senior Administrative Officer, ₹. 500 per day for Office Assistant cum Data Operator.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelors / Masters Degree in any discipline from a reputed institution. Senior Administrative Officer: minimum 5 years of administration experience. Office Assistant cum Data Operator: computer knowledge and Marathi & English typing 30 w.p.m. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Office Assistant cum Data Operator: Marathi & English typing 30 w.p.m. Office Assistant cum Data Operator: good knowledge of Computer, Windows OS, Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel).

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Eligible candidates will be informed about the interview by email or telephone. Candidates must attend the interview at their own expense.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary engagement for a project that will continue till the end of March 2028. University reserves the right to close the project before the term. Services will be terminated immediately if work is unsatisfactory.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Internal Quality Assurance Cell, Shivaji University, Kolhapur.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Application; Attested copies of educational certificates.
